architecture: Mirrored decoder; LayerNorm and GELU at the two hidden layers
input_transform: log1p(10000 * RNA_counts / RNA_depth); technical PuroR excluded from depth and features
objective: Symmetric binomial0.5 UMI thinning, A predicts B and B predicts A, equal mean over positive target-cell directions

technical_holdout.rule: Deterministic SHA-256 of namespace,fold_id,seed,source-scoped row_id below0.05*2^256

terminal_short_batch_policy: Carry unused admitted rows across source chunks/epochs; preserve exact remainder/cursor in checkpoints
training_thinning_seed: Accepted update index; explicit source-scoped row identity makes halves independent of microbatch partition
audit_population: All technical-holdout positive-RNA cells from the exact fitting donors/conditions
audit_reduction: Sum cell-direction normalized count cross-entropies / number of positive target-cell directions
selection: Minimum audit cross-entropy; exact ties use earlier accepted update
center_scale: Selected encoder, fitting positive-RNA nontechnical-holdout cells only, population variance ddof0, standard-deviation floor max(1e-6,0.01*median_positive_fitting_std)
frozen_use: Every dynamics candidate on a training subset uses that subset's identical selected observation model and center/scale
held_out_donor_access: No held-out donors in fitting, audit, scaling or checkpoint selection
runtime_precision: FP32 model; FP64 audit reductions and streamed scaling moments; CUDA proof pending
